_comments.botMentions: Strings that count as '@ the bot' inside groups: the bot phone number form, its LID form, and its display name.
_comments.groupLabels: Optional short labels per group convoId. Recommended when group ids share a prefix.
_comments.ownerDm: Your own DM conversation id (the @lid of your chat with the bot). Find it in messages.jsonl after messaging the bot once.
_comments.triggers: Owner-only DM phrases: toMain routes owner DMs straight to the main chat; toSidechat routes them back to the DM side chat. Must appear at the very start of the message.
